products.title: 5x5 Custom Canopy Tent Package – Steel Frame with Full-Color Printing
products.description:
Specsheet Warning Label Fire Certificate

- Heavy-duty steel frame + wheeled carry bag

- Dye-sublimation printed 600D Oxford fabric

- Waterproof, Fire Resistant, UV Protection

- Free Ground Shipping (FedEx) Nationwide

Features

- Canopy is constructed of durable, weather-resistant 600 denier polyester

- Your artwork will be dye sublimated on a white canopy

- Crank-up canopy creates a taut, clean peak

- Frame is constructed of Steel

- Frame features ABS glass-filled nylon joints

- Square-shaped legs are 1.75" in diameter

- Legs feature plastic levers for pinch-free height adjustment

- Easily collapses to fit inside the included soft case with wheels

- The tent can be secured to the ground with the included stake kit

- Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation

Kit Includes

- 1: Hardware (Frame)

- 1: Canopy

- 1: Wheeled Carry Bag

- 1: Ropes and Pegs Set

Optional Accessories

- 6' Table Cover

- Feather Flags

- Sandbags

Materials

- Hardware: ABS Nylon, Steel

- Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

- Meets FR Rating Requirements

- Primary Usage

- Outdoor

products.description:
Specsheet Warning Label Fire Certificate

Custom Food Booth Canopy Tent Package 5x5

Make your food stand unforgettable with our premium 5x5 Custom Canopy Tent Package, designed especially for food vendors, farmers’ markets, and outdoor events. This compact, professional-grade canopy combines durability, ventilation, and full customization to help your booth stand out from the crowd.

Key Features:

products.title: LED Light Bars for Canopy Tents
products.description:
LED Light Bars for Canopy Tents

Brighten up your booth and stand out at any event with our LED Light Bars for Canopy Tents — the perfect lighting solution for food vendors, trade shows, night markets, and outdoor festivals. Designed to deliver powerful illumination while remaining lightweight and easy to install, these LED bars ensure your products and branding stay visible, day or night.

💡 Ultra-Bright Illumination: High-output LED bars provide even, consistent lighting across your entire canopy.
🔆 3 Light Modes: Switch between Daylight, Warm, and Amber settings to match the mood, event style, or time of day.
🔋 Energy-Efficient LEDs: Long-lasting, low-power-consumption lights designed for all-day use.
⚙️ Easy Installation: Mounts securely to canopy tent frames—no tools required.
🎪 Universal Fit: Compatible with most 10x10, 10x15, and 10x20 canopy tent structures.
🔌 Multiple Power Options: Includes AC adapter for standard outlets; battery-pack compatible (optional).
🎒 Portable & Lightweight: Designed for quick setup, takedown, and transport.
🌙 Perfect for Night Events: Ideal for food booths, vendor displays, art shows, and evening festivals.
🛠️ Durable Build: Shock-resistant housing suitable for repeated outdoor use.

What’s Included:

- (4) Light Bars

- Carrying Bag

- Outlet Power Cable

- USB Power Cable

- Battery Power Cable

- 12V auxiliary Power Cable

- Extension Cables

- Switch Cable

- 2-Way Connector

- 4-Way Connector

- Canopy Clips

- Screw Mount Clips

- Cable Ties (Hook-and-loop)

- Zip Ties

Additional Notes:

- 8 light bars is the max limit to connect

- If used with a metal frame, lights can attach with the magnet that is on the back of them.

- Lights have 3 tones: Daylight, Warm Light, and Amber (bug repelling)

- 6 watts per light, 680 lumens, Voltage：12v, 0.5 amps. ETL Certified

Primary Usage:

Food booths, vendor tents, farmers’ markets, night events, trade shows, craft fairs, outdoor festivals.

products.description:
📦

Portable Power Station 300W, Outdoor Solar Generator Backup Battery Pack 220Wh/60000mAh

About this item

- PORTABLE POWER STATION WITH ENHANCED CAPACITY: Experience the convenience with our 300W portable power station. Designed with a sleek and compact form factor measuring 8.5 x 6.7 x 4.1 inches and weighing a mere 5 lbs, this battery station is your perfect companion for home, camping, and beyond. Equipped with an upgraded 220Wh/60000mAh lithium-ion battery pack, powerful enough to charge up to 7 devices simultaneously.

- PORTABLE SOLAR POWER BANK WITH 7 OUTPUTS: This portable solar power bank battery pack features with 7 outlets. 2x110V AC outlet Pure Sine Wave to charge appliances within 300W(600W Peak),3 USB ports (5V/3.1A Max), 1 USB port (5V/3A, 9V/2A), and 1 DC vehicle output port (9-12.6V, 10A max), this portable solar power bank compatible with a wide range of devices. Enjoy simultaneous charging without any disruptive fan noise, ensuring a serene and comfortable environment wherever you are

- SOLAR GENERATOR OPTIONAL: This 300W power station power bank with AC outlet can also be recharged by solar panel for unparalleled flexibility to become a solar power generator station, apart from the traditional AC wall adapter and car charging methods.The 300W power station provides real-time energy level updates during recharging and discharging, along with AC output status indicators to prevent unexpected power interruptions. With enhanced recharging options for faster and more convenient charging.

- BIGGER LED, BRIGHTER LIGHT: The portable power station 300W designed with premium quality LED light source on the whole back with bigger Led light, offering you a full sense of security in a dark night indoors and outdoors.

- SECURED POWER STATION BANK: Our power station bank for camping boasts an advanced BMS that guarantees voltage control, optimal temperature regulation, and top-tier safety features. Silent cooling vents maintain a secure operating temperature, while built-in protections against short-circuits and overpower scenarios, offering unparalleled peace of mind. Also, the Pure Sine Wave AC inverter can better protect your sensitive devices, preserving battery life and ensuring user/device safety.

- WHAT YOU GET: Apowking 220Wh/300W Rated(600W Peak) portable generator/power station x 1, AC power adapter x 1, car charging cable x 1, cigarette lighter socket to DC adapter x 1, user manua x 1.

- PROTECTING TIPS: 1.Ensure the electricity power station is fully charged before use.2.If not in use for an extended period, recharge the stored battery every 2-3 months and maintain it between 40%-70% capacity. Recharge the battery before it is completely depleted.3.Store the battery in a dry environment within the temperature range of 40°F~100°F (4°C~35°C) or in moisture-proof packaging. Keep it away from heat sources and avoid direct sunlight exposure NOTE: 1.This 300W generator is designed to support devices with a power consumption lower than 300 Watt Hours. It may not be suitable for high-capacity products such as Electric Grills, Induction Cookers, Microwaves, and Refrigerators 2.When you activate the AC output function, it is normal to see a red triangle indicator for AC output verification, which will disappear within 3-5 seconds 3.The high-quality lithium-ion batteries in this generator are capable of supporting over 1000 charge cycles, ensuring long-term battery performance, reliability, and safety

🔹 Key Features

- ⚡ 300W AC Output – Dual pure sine wave AC outlets for stable power

- 🔋 220Wh Lithium Battery – Compact but powerful for multiple devices

- 🔌 Multi-Port Charging – USB-A, USB-C, and DC outputs for phones, laptops, tablets, and other gear

- 🏕️ Portable & Lightweight – Easy to carry and transport for travel or outdoor use

- 🛡️ Safety Protection – Built-in BMS system guards against overload and short circuits

- ☀️ Versatile Power Source – Ideal for camping, home backup, RVs, emergencies, and outdoor activities

🔹 Why You’ll Love It

- Great for off-grid power needs

- Supports essential electronics during outages

- Quick and convenient setup

- Durable construction for rugged use

🔹 Best Suited For

Portable outdoor power, camping trips, tailgating, emergency backup, RV and travel adventures, and remote work setups.
